How to run the camera check
  1. Hold the paper still and choose Pick paper color. Click the paper in the picture.
  2. Place the two lines inside the visible drop path. Keep them fixed across all ten trials.
  3. Choose Arm next drop, then release the paper from above the upper line. For a recording, scrub to just before a drop and arm it.
  4. Review each result. Mark the upper and lower crossings in the replay and save the manual check.
  5. Download the CSV and keep the clips. The initial software checks use generated inputs; this session checks your actual setup.
